subject: Re: MAP starter + week0 runbook — Helios AI evaluation
messages:
From: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helios.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: MAP starter + week0 runbook request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency profiling and autoscaling examples were helpful. We discussed putting together a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so our engineering + procurement teams can align on acceptance criteria, timeline, and dependencies.

Could you share a concise MAP template (doc + lightweight slide stub) you typically use for 30-day pilots? We want something we can review internally and then iterate with your CS team. Key things our VP of Eng will want to see:
- Evaluation success criteria (perf / accuracy / SLOs)
- Data ingress/egress and security checkpoints
- Timeline for pilot hardware and onboard slots
- Demo and final acceptance gating

If possible, please include a suggested week0 runbook and a rough close timeline so procurement knows the decision window. Our target is to complete the pilot and decide within 30–45 days.

Attaching the security questionnaire our InfoSec team will send to you. Happy to do a quick 30-min sync tomorrow afternoon to kickoff.

Thanks,
Claire Zhang
Director of Product
Helios AI

Attachment: Helios_Security_QS.pdf (PDF, 86 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helios.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter + week0 runbook request

Claire — really glad the demo landed. Appreciate the clarity on the decision window.

I've created a lean MAP starter doc and a compact week0 runbook slide deck that we use for 30–45 day pilots. Quick notes:
- MAP doc is organized into Objectives, Acceptance Criteria (Tech + Business), Dependencies, Roles, and Timeline (week-by-week milestones).
- Week0 runbook is a one-slide checklist for tech-ready items (API keys, test dataset presence, IP allowlist, instance sizing) and a 30/60/90 acceptance cadence.

Links:
- MAP starter doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2b_MAP_Template_v1
- Week0 runbook slides: https://drive.google.com/file/d/0B_week0_runbook_slides

I'll attach the doc stubs and a brief example MAP we used for a recent pilot (removed customer PII). Can Marissa + Jonas weigh in on the pilot milestones and acceptance gating so we can tailor criteria for Helios? Proposed rough timeline below.

Proposed (high level):
- Week0 (1–5): Access + baseline perf test, model selection & quantization plan
- Week1–2: Integration + end-to-end perf validation (latency & throughput)
- Week3: Feature validation with live data subset + business KPI check-in
- Week4: Final acceptance run + deploy plan for production or next-step commitment

If that aligns, I'll open the MAP doc and add Helios-specific lanes. Happy to run the 30-min kickoff tomorrow at 3:00pm PT — otherwise suggest Thursday.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior AE, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP_Template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc stub), week0-runbook-slides.pptx (PowerPoint stub)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Claire Zhang <c.zhang@helios.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-29 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter + week0 runbook request

Hi Claire — looping in a couple of checklist items from our delivery side and a slightly tighter acceptance proposal so your VP of Eng can validate quickly.

Acceptance criteria (technical) — suggested minimums:
- 95th percentile token latency under 250ms for the primary inference path at simulated concurrency of 8
- End-to-end throughput benchmark that meets your peak batch forecast (+20% buffer)
- Data handling: test dataset processed within customer VPC or agreed secure channel; logs retained per contract

Dependencies / pre-reqs for week0:
- Service account + API key (we will provide an example)
- Test dataset (anonymized) + sample request shapes
- Network allowlist (we can provide IPs)

Week0 runbook (quick):
1) Kickoff sync — confirm stakeholders + runbook owner (day 0)
2) Access & smoke tests (day 1–2)
3) Baseline perf + KV cache priming (day 3)
4) Integration checks + acceptance criteria review (day 4–5)

Jonas — can you add a short note in the MAP about fallback policies if peak capacity isn't met and a suggested ramp for dedicated capacity? That will help procurement.

Claire — if you like this, I can slot a technical kickoff with our infra engineer (Jonas) right after the 30-min alignment to go over allowlist and dataset details.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-03-30 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP starter + week0 runbook request

Thanks — that looks great. Confirming the high-level timeline is acceptable to us. Two quick asks from procurement & security:
1) Can you add an explicit decision gate doc for procurement that lists contract milestones and typical lead times (billing + SLAs)?
2) We attached Helios_Security_QS.pdf — our SecOps would like to see your SOC-2 scope and a pointer to where audit logs are retained.

Also, please go ahead and create the MAP in the doc link you shared and add Helios stakeholders as editors (Claire + me). We'll aim to run the week0 kickoff on Thursday at 10:00am PT.

Tom Rivers
VP, Procurement & Strategy
Helios AI

Attachment: Helios_Security_QS.pdf (referenced; included in prior mail)
